description: Message type, frame flags, and where relevant the HELLO capability offer, for every ATP body under tests/conformance/. A wire body is just bytes: nothing in the filename or the file says which message it is or which flags accompanied it, so that pairing is recorded here. Everything else is derived rather than restated -- the directory decides the expectation (valid/ must be accepted, invalid/ must be rejected), and AML and sanitization vectors are discovered from the filesystem. A WELCOME body cannot be judged alone -- "may select only names HELLO offered" is a claim about a connection, not about bytes -- so those entries carry the offer the vector is judged against. dustnet-core's conformance_vectors test reads this file, and fails if a .atp file on disk has no entry or an entry names no file.
